record.edic_text:
2670 katapontizo {kat-ap-on-tid'-zo}

from 2596 and a derivative of the same as 4195;; v

AV - sink 1, drown 1; 2

1) to plunge or sink into the sea
   1a) to sink, to go down
   1b) a grievous offender for the purpose of killing him, to drown
